text: {"differences":[{"evidence":"Master's degree from UC Berkeley vs Bachelor's degree from MIT","dimension":"educational level","description":"This captures how advanced the candidate's formal computer-science degree is.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"5 years of software development experience vs 3 years","dimension":"experience depth","description":"This captures the amount of relevant professional software-development experience claimed.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"6 production services vs 4 production services","dimension":"delivery scope","description":"This captures how many production systems the applicant says they have helped test, maintain, or launch.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"5 other languages vs 2 others","dimension":"language breadth","description":"This captures how many additional programming languages the applicant reports using beyond Go.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"Personal utility application, developed and kept current","dimension":"ongoing side project","description":"This captures evidence of maintaining a personal software project outside of work.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"Capture-the-flag security competitions on a recurring basis","dimension":"security practice","description":"This captures active participation in hands-on offensive-security practice outside of formal work experience.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"Statements about fit and motivations placed earlier in the letter","dimension":"argument order","description":"This captures where the candidate chooses to emphasize fit, motivation, and technical credentials within the letter structure.","winner":"B"}]}
